page_title: BHA 2-1 BRE | Brighton v Brentford 06/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Ben Mee (Brentford) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post.
90+4' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

88' Ben Mee (Brentford) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
84' Substitution. Myles Peart-Harris (Brentford) on for Mads Roerslev Rasmussen.
84' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Jakub Moder (Brighton) replaces Carlos Baleba.
84' Simon Adingra goes off the pitch and Benicio Baker-Boaitey (Brighton) comes on.

83' Simon Adingra (Brighton) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
81' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

81' Mark Flekken stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Simon Adingra (Brighton) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' The corner kick from Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
80' Simon Adingra (Brighton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
80' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:7.
76' Yellow card! It's like Billy Gilmour (Brighton) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Peter Bankes agrees and books him.
76' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Yoane Wissa (Brentford).
74' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jack Hinshelwood walks off the pitch to be replaced by Joel Veltman (Brighton).

73' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. It will be a corner kick for Brentford.
73' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
72' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford). Brentford have a corner.
71' Jason Steele displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
69' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Shandon Baptiste.
69' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Joao Pedro will be replaced by Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
69' It is time for a substitution. James Milner (Brighton) is on for Facundo Buonanotte.
68' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
67' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.

64' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
64' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) will take the free kick.

63' Simon Adingra (Brighton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Mark Flekken!
61' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Peter Bankes saw the whole situation.
60' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
58' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
54' Joao Pedro (Brighton) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar.
52' 2 - 1 Goal! Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Pascal Gross and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 2:1.

51' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
51' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Neal Maupay (Brentford) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
49' Mark Flekken pulls off a great save to deny Joao Pedro (Brighton), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
48' Joao Pedro (Brighton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
46' Thomas Frank has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Keane Lewis-Potter comes on the pitch for Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
46' The whistle blows and Peter Bankes starts the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+8' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
45+7' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
45+6' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
45+6' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+6' Joao Pedro (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
45+4' Simon Adingra (Brighton) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
45+1' Pascal Gross (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
44' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
43' The free kick is delivered by Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
42' Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul after Carlos Baleba (Brighton) hacks down one of his opponents. Brentford win a free kick.

41' The corner is slung over and Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
41' Corner kick. Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is ready to send the ball into the box.
40' The ball is cleared after Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Brighton will have an opportunity.
40' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is being substituted because of an injury. Thomas Frank sends Yoane Wissa on the pitch.
36' Looks like Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
35' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
35' Pascal Gross (Brighton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
33' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
31' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Pascal Gross (Brighton) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Kaoru Mitoma provided an assist for the goal.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jason Steele to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
26' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
25' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
25' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is penalised for holding. Peter Bankes signals a set piece. That is a penalty kick for Brentford.

22' Simon Adingra (Brighton) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
22' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
20' Pascal Gross (Brighton) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play. Brighton win a corner kick.
18' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
18' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) prepares to take a corner kick.
17' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
16' Half-chance! Frank Onyeka (Brentford) plays a pass into the box, but Jason Steele reacts well to snuff out the attack.
12' Brighton decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
12' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) trips an opposition player and Peter Bankes signals a foul. A free kick is awarded to Brighton.
9' Brighton keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
5' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton), but Mark Flekken is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
3' A pass from Joao Pedro (Brighton) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Brighton will take the kick-off.
Peter Bankes will referee today's match.
